title: Storage overview
purpose: See at a glance where there is room: repository-wide position counts, occupancy of each active storage unit and the most recent box and rack moves. Every count links to the list it counts.

sections.title: All active storage
paragraphs: Position counts cover positions in active boxes that sit in active racks, shelves and storage units. Retired structure is never counted as capacity. Installed is every such position; Blocked are positions held out of use; Occupied have an item stored in them; Free is installed minus blocked minus occupied. Free positions are not reserved: a position is claimed only when an item is stored in it.
Nominal temperature is a stated set point, not a measurement.

items.label: Storage units
items.description: Number of active storage units; links to the Storage units list.

items.label: Boxes
items.description: Number of active boxes; links to the Boxes list.

items.label: Positions
items.description: All installed positions in active boxes under active structure.

items.label: Free
items.description: Positions neither blocked nor occupied; links to the Free positions list.

sections.title: Occupancy by storage unit
paragraphs: One row per active storage unit, ordered by site, room, then unit code. Retired units are not listed here.

items.label: Storage unit
items.description: Unit code and name; opens the unit.

items.label: Storage class
items.description: The class named when the unit was set up.

items.label: Nominal (°C)
items.description: The unit's stated set point in degrees Celsius. A definition, not a measurement; it never blocks storing an item.

items.label: Free
items.description: Links to the Free positions list filtered to that unit. A unit whose positions are all taken shows Full; a unit with no boxes yet shows No positions.

sections.title: Recent box and rack moves
paragraphs: The ten most recently recorded moves of a box or a rack, newest recorded first. A Correction tag marks a record that corrects an earlier move. Moves of single specimens are not listed here.

items.label: Moved
items.description: The box or rack that moved; opens it.

items.label: Moved at
items.description: When the move happened, in repository local time (not when it was recorded).

items.label: From, To
items.description: Location and slot before and after, as recorded at the time.

items.label: By
items.description: The person who recorded the move.

sections.title: Empty state
paragraphs: With no active storage unit the page offers New storage unit to users who may manage storage; other roles see the message only.
